notes: Static functional inventory from docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §6.5/§13, DESIGN.md §14, FEATURES.md, CONTRACTS.md, forge-spec.json, NibContracts and feature registrations/UI source. Saved as tools/qa/matrix.json; no commit, build or UI execution performed. Owners are forge F### IDs. Each explicitly listed option, source, mode, gesture and shortcut is a separate test variant, even when one row groups variants of the same control. Paths use visible English labels; cmd.<command> selectors must be scoped by label/container because several controls share an ID. Tool IDs come from feature CanvasToolDescriptor registrations; no central ToolIDs enum was found. Probe means JSON accessibilityValue of nib.qa.state in UI-test mode: screen, document, page, pageCount, tool, zoom, contentOffset{x,y}, itemCountOnPage, strokeCountOnPage, selectionCount, undoAvailable, redoAvailable, openPanels, paletteDock{edge,along}, fixtureError. Use visible UI/output files for properties absent from probe; library panels/sheets are not all session-tracked. Wait for fixtureError=null and screen ready, then eventual visible/probe state rather than fixed delays. For each applicable mutation verify undo/redo and reopen persistence; settings/session-only actions must not create document undo entries; palette docking has window undo when document history is empty. Test destructive confirmations both ways, picker cancellation, invalid inputs, empty/disabled states, read-only/locked restrictions and current-window isolation. Run regular/compact iPad, iPhone, portrait/landscape, light/dark, accessibility text sizes, VoiceOver and Reduce Motion where relevant. Pencil pressure/hover/squeeze/roll/haptics, camera, Face ID, speech, external display, external apps, notifications and multi-device/provider flows require supported hardware or controlled fixtures; simulator limitations are not passes. SPEC GAP rows are unimplemented/unverified routes, not assertions of working UI. Runtime uses ⌘9 for last tab and ⌥⌘0 for Actual Size; view.zoom fit means notebook width/board content, not a separate full-page-fit command. DESIGN command bar was not found; ⌘K is registered for text links. Core query/node/asset/render APIs are not standalone buttons; their user-visible consumers are covered. FEATURES n/a account/store/paywall/server-only products are excluded; documented local substitutes are included. F097 managed configuration and F100 metrics have no settings UI; their backend APIs are not invented as controls. Additional SPEC GAP rows retain required creation/AI/conversion functionality whose UI route was not found. Tests were not changed.
